budgets.feature_off_time_estimator: median(new_time_i / old_time_i) for adjacent paired captures

enabled_measurement_provenance: Enabled stage benchmarks precede the final hoist of the engine lookup out of GCode::append_full_config. That function is not called by the enabled benchmark capture (which measures emit_print directly). All measured enabled-stage source functions are unchanged.

timing_noise_characterization.method: All six old/new workloads alternated capture order with fixed CPU affinity 0x3, one discarded warmup and 100 measured pairs. Earlier five- and twenty-pair results are retained; no commands or timing samples were filtered.
